name: Відволікання (2)
description: You have to come up with a clever move to get rid of that defender. You have already learned a lot of techniques to eliminate a defender. Concepts like deflection (via sacrifice) or capturing should no longer surprise you. Good luck eliminating all those defenders!

examples.text: The queen covers the knight, but White can change that by attacking the black queen. The queen flees, but now White wins a piece!

texts: Try to undermine the defense of the central black knight.
